summary:
Main
• Capesize Spot Rates Hit Two-month Lows - Although Capesize spot rates have declined by approximately $20,000 from their early-September multi-year highs, they remain comfortably above the $30,000 threshold, representing a 40% yearover-year increase. This recent retreat likely stems from iron ore transportation costs hitting a decade-high percentage of the commodity's price, which has subsequently stifled inquiry from smaller, cost-constrained miners. However, elevated futures trading at a premium to spot rates (contango structure) indicate widespread market optimism that this downturn is temporary.
